BiblicalUsage: Pasach, son of Japhlet of the tribe of Asher, appears once in the genealogies of the Chronicler. His name means cut off, and nothing else is recorded of him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God counts His people one by one: a name in a genealogy is not filler, it is a person He knows.
